## Visualizing Your Data

More details to follow. The gist of it is this: you'll take one of the datasets you submitted in Project 1 and create a visualization that you will present to the class in a lightining round (3 mins, 3 slides max) the Thursday after Fall Break. 

Here's the catch -- you'll need to use a plot geometry that we haven't yet covered in class.

Your grading will be on the following:

- Description of the data setting (very brief)
- The plot itself
- A short summary of how it's used (what are the required aesthetic mappings)
- A short description of what your plot shows

More details to follow. Remember, this is a 3-minute presentation that we'll run back-to-back-to-back over all the groups, so efficiency is key. The plot has to hit fast and hard.
